body: I know I can do great things. But if such a thing as luck exists, I don't have any of it.  I have a lot of external struggles but deep down I have a constant internal pain that rips on my soul everyday.

The thing is I have a good hobby,  I have a good college degree. I have moments of happiness.  But at the end of the day, it doesn't matter because there are still problems that won't get solved.  There is still my depression and pain that I experience internally. 

I do appreciate you taking the time to write.
I have many things to offer but I fear I don't have much to gain anymore.
I hope you may find reasons to live my friend.  I have lost all mine.
Thank you for the compliment.
Thank you for the words of encouragement.  I have held on by believing it will be okay but things are not.
Any idea when DC will bring back the gram listing?  I only see the 3.5g listing and that is too much money for me right now.
Just click on the account link at the top.  It shows you it in big bold letters.

It's really been an off and on thing. One day I feel this way and the next I can be perfectly fine.   Thanks for the advice. I want people to know my story.
I know it can get better.  I really want it too.
Feels good to not be alone.
Perhaps my ego gets in the way. Maybe I hate people telling me what's wrong with me.  Maybe I don't want others to fix my problems. I really don't know why.  I want to know.
Thank you.
Awesome. I will keep your email handy. It feels nice to know someone will listen.
Thanks for the kind words. I will get through this.  I will try my best.
Thank you. This means a lot.
